title: Apple’s reportedly raising the price for AppleCare Plus on Macs and iPads
summary: An AppleCare Plus subscription for a Mac or iPad will cost more soon, with prices going up by $0.50 per month or $5 per year for new sign-ups while remaining the same for existing subscribers, according to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman.
